explanation: The core defect was that the slice expression `xs[k:] + xs[:k]` performs a LEFT rotation by k, while the spec requires a RIGHT rotation for positive k (e.g., rotate([1,2,3], 1) returned [2,3,1] instead of [3,1,2]). After normalizing k with `k %= len(xs)` (which also correctly maps negative k, i.e., left rotations, to an equivalent right rotation), the correct right-rotation expression is `xs[-k:] + xs[:-k]`, which moves the last k elements to the front. The empty-input guard was already correct and also guards against modulo-by-zero. The abnormally indented body was normalized to standard indentation.
